## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass.
- [ ] `bun run e2e` passes when the change touches the window, the viewport, the chat, or the offline engine.
- [ ] Tests cover every behavior change.
- [ ] The README and `docs/` describe the new behavior.
- [ ] No screenshot or file shows account data.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits.
